name: single-arm suspension power pull
description: A powerful one-arm row on a suspension strap that trains the lats, upper back and trunk rotation control.
instructions: Hold one suspension handle with one hand and lean back with your feet planted.
Keep your body long and reach the free arm forward as you lower away from the anchor.
Pull the handle toward your chest with a strong, controlled effort, allowing your torso to rotate slightly toward the working arm.
Lower slowly, keeping your hips from dropping, then switch sides.
